summary: Black Hawk Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting issuance of a $300,000 convertible promissory note to its sponsor, Black Hawk Management LLC, for working capital. The 10% note matures upon a deSPAC business combination or liquidation. At deSPAC, the sponsor may convert principal into post-combination common shares at $1.00 per share. The note is unsecured with the sponsor waiving trust-account claims. This is routine SPAC bridge financing ahead of a potential business combination, not a definitive deal announcement. The filing signals ongoing search activity but lacks target details or negotiations.
